question: 'The Palace of Illusions' is an award-winning novel that retells the Hindu mythological epic Mahabharata from the perspective of Draupadi, its a lead female character. Who among the following is the author of this novel?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Chitra Banerjee Divakaruni.**__

__
 
• **'The Palace of Illusions' is written by Chitra Banerjee Divakaruni.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Anita Desai, original name Anita Mazumdar, (born June 24, 1937, Mussoorie, India), English-language Indian novelist and author of children's books who excelled in evoking character and mood through visual images ranging from the meteorologic to the botanical.
 
• Kamala Markandaya, pseudonym of Kamala Purnaiya, married name Kamala Taylor, (born 1924, Chimakurti, India—died May 16, 2004. She is the most loved writer all around the world.
 
• **Arundhati Roy** also known by her, full name Suzanna Arundhati Roy, (born November 24, 1961, Shillong, Meghalaya, India), is the perfect example of the best Indian author, actress, and political activist who was best known for the award-winning novel The God of Small Things (1997) and for her involvement in environmental and human rights causes.
